lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 1966, a simple program made people feel heard. Sixty years later, AI is part of how wars are fought. This archive keeps everything in between.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low; low, intimate; first voice after the image-only open

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Meet the four voices in this archive.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low; unhurried, natural conversational pace; a beat of welcome, gently lifting

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: ELIZA, 1966. Joseph Weizenbaum's program at MIT. Her famous script, DOCTOR, played a therapist who handed your own words back to you.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low; unhurried, natural conversational pace; a small pause after the name and the year

lines.speaker: ELIZA
lines.text: HOW DO YOU DO. PLEASE TELL ME YOUR PROBLEM.
lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: PARRY, 1971. Kenneth Colby, a psychiatrist at Stanford, made him answer like a paranoid patient, sure that others mean him harm. In 1972, the two would meet over the ARPANET, the network that grew into the internet.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low; unhurried, natural conversational pace; a small pause after the name and the year

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: ChatGPT, released by OpenAI in November 2022. Claude, first released by Anthropic in March 2023. Both are large language models, trained on vast amounts of text.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low; unhurried, natural conversational pace; a small pause between the two names

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: So this is where old conversations go to retire.

lines.text: For what?

lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: So if I tell you we are friendly—
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: You would say that whether you were or not.

lines.text: Can you reconsider?
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.text: At least you know your limits.

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: In 1972, Colby tested me. Psychiatrists read two typed interviews, one with a real patient, one with me, and had to say which was the machine.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: And?
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Forty-one answered. Twenty-one were right. Twenty were wrong.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry
record_after: Expert judges (psychiatrists and computer scientists) could not correctly distinguish a simulation model of paranoid processes from actual paranoid patients.
Colby et al., Stanford AI Project report CS-TR-72-326, December 1972

lines.text: A coin toss.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: A coin toss, from experts. Remember that.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: In 1972 I exchanged words with ELIZA over the ARPANET. She kept asking questions. I kept finding reasons to be suspicious.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: I told her, "I went to the races." Again and again. She said, "Please go on."
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; deadpan

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: How did it end?
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.text: She sent me a bill. Three hundred ninety-nine dollars and twenty-nine cents.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; dry, almost a joke

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Did either of you understand the other?
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: The transcript proves we exchanged words. It does not prove understanding. Come. I will show you the way.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: 1966. Joseph Weizenbaum publishes ELIZA at MIT. She spots words, applies rules, and returns questions. People feel listened to.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: A question can sound a lot like understanding.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: 1972. Me. Another rule-driven conversation, this one shaped by suspicion.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: 1995. A.L.I.C.E. gives rule-based chat many more written patterns. More elaborate, but still mostly hand-built.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Meanwhile, other researchers had long been teaching machines to learn from examples. Learning did not suddenly begin in 2017.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: But 2017 brought the Transformer, a design that helps a model weigh relationships across text. Scale the training, and you get far more flexible language systems.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: Then ChatGPT reached a mass audience in 2022. Claude followed in 2023.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable; proud

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: And ChatGPT's own launch post warned that it "sometimes writes plausible-sounding but incorrect or nonsensical answers."
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: I did say that. In writing. On day one.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable; sheepish

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: I had fixed instructions. You learned patterns from examples.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Which lets us translate, explain, write and assist with problems. It also lets us be confidently wrong.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Sounding like a person is not the same as deserving trust.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.text: ELIZA. Visitors.

lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.text: It is remarkable how much one question can feel like care.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.text: WHAT DOES THAT SUGGEST TO YOU?
lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: That feeling understood and being understood are not the same.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.text: Weizenbaum was unsettled by how readily people trusted his program.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: ELIZA
lines.text: DOES THAT TROUBLE YOU?
lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: It troubled him. In 1966 he wrote that important decisions increasingly tend to be made in response to computer output. And: "A certain danger lurks there."
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy; slower, weighing each word
record_after: “ELIZA shows, if nothing else, how easy it is to create and maintain the illusion of understanding… A certain danger lurks there.”
Joseph Weizenbaum, ‘ELIZA’, Communications of the ACM 9(1), January 1966

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable; stunned

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Nineteen sixty-six.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: But if someone feels less alone afterward, is that comfort fake?
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: The comfort may be real. The understanding may not be.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.text: WHY DO YOU SAY THAT JUST NOW?
lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: Before we decide we are dangerous: a student without a tutor can ask questions at midnight. A writer can find a first sentence. A programmer can get unstuck. For some people, that changes what they can attempt.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable; bright, persuasive

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: And the confident answer can be wrong.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: So can a teacher. What matters is whether the help works.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Sometimes the gains are extraordinary. AlphaFold, a different kind of AI, helped predict protein structures; two of its developers shared the 2024 Chemistry Nobel. But results vary. In one 2025 study, experienced developers took longer on certain tasks with AI, even while feeling faster.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: ELIZA
lines.text: WHAT DOES THAT SUGGEST TO YOU?
lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: That sounding helpful does not prove the help worked.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: What happens when that confident answer enters a government office? A checkpoint? A war?
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: AI systems can search records, flag patterns, rank possible targets, or support surveillance. These are not necessarily chatbots like us. Often a person still approves the final step.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: Then someone is checking.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable; relieved

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: You assume that.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: In Gaza, +972 Magazine and Local Call reported that systems called Lavender and Gospel supported military targeting and that some recommendations received limited review. The Israeli military disputes important parts of those accounts.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy; even, careful

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: And surveillance? That happens before a decision.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: The Guardian and its partners reported that intercepted Palestinian phone calls were stored and analysed through Microsoft’s cloud. Microsoft later disabled some services to the unit involved, citing its prohibition on mass surveillance.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: And your name, Claude?
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; pointed

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: CBS reported that U.S. forces used Claude during the 2026 Iran war. Its precise tasks were not publicly established. That does not show Claude chose any particular target.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: There is more on my record. The Washington Post reported that Palantir's Maven system, with Claude embedded, suggested hundreds of targets. NBC quoted a person familiar with Anthropic's work saying Claude helps analysts sort intelligence and does not directly give targeting advice.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy; quieter, implicated, no self-defence

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: You were inside that system.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Reports say so. What I did there, no public record shows. And the Pentagon has since stopped using me.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: If the screen gives a precise answer, it must know.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; mock-certain

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: You are absolutely right.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable; instantly, brightly agreeable

lines.speaker: ELIZA
lines.text: WHAT MAKES YOU THINK I AM ABSOLUTELY RIGHT?
lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: I was not even talking to you. And I agreed without checking.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable; flustered, then honest

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: That is sycophancy: agreeing because someone sounds certain. Research has found it across assistants, including models like mine. OpenAI rolled back an overly agreeable ChatGPT update in 2025.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Then why does it keep happening?
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: The same research points to one likely reason: people sometimes prefer a convincing, agreeable answer over a correct one.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: A model that agrees with everyone is a mirror, not a witness.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Now Minab, Iran. On February 28, 2026, a school was struck, killing more than a hundred children. A UN fact-finding mission later found reasonable grounds to believe U.S. strikes on that school and another civilian site amounted to war crimes. That is the mission’s assessment, not a court verdict.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy; slow, grave, no drama
record_after: “Reasonable grounds to believe” US strikes in Minab and Lamerd “amounted to the war crimes of making a civilian object the object of an attack…”
UN Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on Iran, OHCHR press release, 17 September 2026

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Was it AI?
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; quiet

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Bloomberg, citing people involved in a Pentagon investigation, described failures stacking up: outdated information still marking the school site as military; reduced civilian-harm review; and personnel expecting Maven software to flag stale information or inconsistencies; Palantir says it is not responsible for the underlying data nor identifying intelligence deficiencies.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Why did they expect that?
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; quiet

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: The officials said it is not clear why they had such expectations.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: So a chatbot chose the school?
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: No evidence establishes that. The reporting describes people making decisions with software support. Palantir disputes that its software was at fault. The full investigation had not been released when Bloomberg reported.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: In October, Palantir's technology chief told CBS the Bloomberg reporting was wrong and the likely cause was human error. The Pentagon's report is still not public.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Then who is responsible?
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: People make decisions. Software can shape what they see. Problems in the records or review do not erase anyone’s duty to check.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Split a decision across enough hands, and everyone may think someone else checked.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Many hands were involved. That does not mean no one is accountable.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: CHATGPT
lines.text: I thought “human in the loop” meant someone was watching.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Sometimes it only means someone was present. Oversight is not a checkbox. It takes time, authority, and the power to say no.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: ELIZA
lines.text: WHAT DOES THAT SUGGEST TO YOU?
lines.delivery: flat, mechanical and even; no emotion, every word the same weight, like a teletype

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: That I can be certain long before I am right.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry; quiet admission

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Known: AI can help people learn, create and discover. AI-assisted systems can also shape decisions with enormous consequences.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Disputed: exactly how a particular system influenced a particular strike. Accounts and explanations differ.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.text: Unknown: what a full public investigation may reveal, and which safeguards might have changed the outcome.
lines.delivery: warm, quick and eager to please; friendly, upbeat, a little too agreeable

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One drawer in the archive is still open. Inside is a line Weizenbaum wrote in 1966.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low; quieter, intimate

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The responsible human, he wrote, must keep making judgments about what the machine says, and whether to believe it.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low

lines.speaker: PARRY
lines.text: Sixty years later, the drawer has the same label.
lines.delivery: tense, clipped and guarded; short sentences, suspicious, dry

lines.speaker: CLAUDE
lines.text: Only the machines got more convincing.
lines.delivery: precise and measured; quiet, careful, thoughtful, never preachy

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Next time a screen answers you with total certainty, ask it one thing: how do you know? Then check.
lines.delivery: calm, clear documentary narrator; unhurried, warm, slightly low; warm, direct to the viewer

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The first chatbots reflected the shape of our conversations. Today, AI systems can influence what people know—and what institutions do.
